Chapter 309 - 309 Science!

Chapter 309 - 309 Science!

309 Science!

The managing editor, who was sleeping, suddenly received a call.

He was like a furious lion.

His voice was terrifyingly low.

When he saw the paper, Principles and Applications of Super Batteries, he immediately became extremely excited and praised Howard Theus.

As the managing editor of Science, he knew very well what this thesis represented.

Some people were extremely proud of their paper being published in Science.

There were also some papers that were published by Science that made Science feel honored.

This thesis on super batteries was the latter.

One had to know…

Science was not the only top journal in the world.

If they did not review and reply immediately.

What if… the other party felt that they had neglected him, so they decided to send the manuscript to Science’s long-time rival, Nature?

At that time… he would definitely regret it.

Therefore, the managing editor immediately forwarded Principles and Applications of Super Batteries to Professor Stephen Jenny of Hemp Rope Technology University.

The next day, Hemp Rope Technology University’s chemistry laboratory was bustling with activity.

…

Lin Fan had no idea about all of this.

These few days, Lin Fan just went to school, slept, and ate. He was experiencing the leisurely life of a student. It was very relaxed and pleasant.

He was relaxed, but Professor Stephen Jenny was the complete opposite.

In the past few days, Professor Stephen had been experimenting and checking the theory of the super battery.

Today, the experimental results finally appeared, and they were completely consistent with the data in the thesis.

The thesis was… correct!

When the editorial department of Science received the feedback, they did not hesitate to publish the thesis and added a prominent title on the cover.

…

At this moment, in the headquarters of a popular mobile phone company in America.

The technical director took a stack of documents and rushed to the president’s office.

“What’s wrong?” Kaku asked curiously.

“Super battery! You’ll know when you see it,” the technical director said.

One should not think that the CEO did not know anything and only knew how to give orders blindly.

On the contrary, the CEO knew much more than the average person.

Kaku quickly flipped through the information. After a moment, his face gradually revealed a hint of shock and solemnity.

“According to the thesis, the battery size of mobile phones can be reduced by at least half, but the capacity can be increased by several times! How authentic is this thesis?”

Nowadays, cell phones were always developing in the direction of being lighter and thinner.

The super battery could undoubtedly achieve the ultimate in this aspect, and it could even be said to be subversive.

It was no wonder that Kaku would show such an expression.

“This paper was reviewed by Professor Stephen Jenny from Hemp Rope Technology University,” the technical director said. “He’s an authority figure on batteries. Also, last night, I did a few last-minute experiments according to the thesis, and the date I got was exactly the same as the data mentioned in the thesis.

“Therefore, there’s no need to doubt the authenticity.”

When Kaku heard this, he turned around a few times before picking up the phone on the table. “Mr. Wilson, I need you to get the contact information of Lin Fan, the author of the Science thesis, Principles and Applications of Super Batteries, as soon as possible! Hurry!”

“Yes, Sir!” Wilson’s serious voice came from the phone.

…

Bangzi Country, Four Star Corporation.

Chairman Lee Kangxi listened to the director’s report and frowned. “Super battery? Moreover, it’s a super battery developed by someone in Hua Nation? You know I hate those two words!”

After a while, Li Kangxi continued, “Now, we must make two preparations.

“First, we need to get in touch with Lin Fan as soon as possible and try to buy the patent for the super battery.

“Secondly, we need to check if Lin Fan from Hua Nation is a nationality of Bangzi Country.”

“Yes, Sir!” the director said respectfully.

…

Hua Nation, Dahua Phone Group.

Chairman Ran Fei had a habit of spending at least an hour a day reading the most cutting-edge scientific research reports.

He knew very well that technology was the only driving force for progress.

When he picked up the latest issue of Science on the table, he was quickly attracted by the title on the cover, Principles and Applications of Super Batteries.

Then, Ran Fei almost buried his entire head in the journal.

After a long while, he muttered to himself excitedly, “The battery capacity can actually be increased by so much…”

Ran Fei quickly dialed a number and said, “Director Liu, have you seen the latest issue of Science?”

“You’re talking about Principles and Applications of Super Batteries, right? I was just about to report this to you,” Director Liu said.

“Oh? What do you think of the thesis? Is it possible?” Ran Fei asked.

“There’s no problem with the basic logic, but the specific data still needs to be verified personally,” Director Liu said.

Ran Fei said, “Put everything aside now. Form a research team of 20 to 50 people and verify the experiment in the shortest time possible!”

“Alright!” Director Liu immediately replied.

Then, Ran Fei dialed the number of the director of the Human Resources Department and said, “Help me get the contact information of Lin Fan from Jiangbei University as soon as possible.”

“Yes, Sir!” the HR director said.

Ran Fei paced around the office. After thinking for a moment, he made another call and said, “Help me book a plane ticket to Jiangbei. The sooner the better!”

…

All the big shots in the mobile phone industry had noticed the thesis, Principles and Applications of Super Batteries.

They all asked their HR department to help them find Lin Fan’s contact information. However, the most they could find was Lin Fan’s email address.

As for his phone number and his house address, they failed to get that information.

In fact, this was normal.

After all, Lin Fan was a member of the Dragon Division, and his identity was encrypted.

In addition, Lin Fan invented the earthquake prediction device and solved many mathematical problems. He also said that he would not accept any interviews.

The officials understood that Lin Fan did not want to be disturbed.

Naturally… no one would know about his information.

They did not manage to find his cell phone number or specific address…

Helpless, the senior executives of the cell phone companies could only send Lin Fan emails.

However, as a young man of the 21st century, why would he check his email regularly?

These emails were destined to be unseen.
